risks.title: Single related-party tenant for the whole new asset
risks.summary: The WGCL center is leased entirely to WGCL, the seller and a WHA-group JV, with no rental guarantee. Default, early termination or non-renewal after 30 years would hit income; the asset is about 4.13% of enlarged-trust rental revenue.

source.section: ความเสี่ยงในการสูญเสียผู้เช่าหลัก ซึ่งอาจทำให้รายได้ของกองทรัสต์ WHART เปลี่ยนแปลงไป
source.quote: มีการให้เช่าเหมาทรัพย์สินแก่ผู้เช่าหลักเพียงรายเดียว

risks.title: Re-letting constraints: specialised use and WGCL's shared rights
risks.summary: The building serves WGCL's resin conveyor/silo operation. A new tenant may pay different rent; multi-tenant conversion (up to 8 units) needs capex; WGCL keeps free shared use of the access road and rainwater pond while it leases adjacent land.

source.section: ความเสี่ยงในการสูญเสียผู้เช่าหลัก ซึ่งอาจทำให้รายได้ของกองทรัสต์ WHART เปลี่ยนแปลงไป
source.quote: สิทธิของดับบลิวจีซีแอลในการใช้ทางเข้าออกและบ่อพักน้ำฝนร่วมกับกองทรัสต์ WHART

risks.title: Building certificate still pending
risks.summary: At 2026-05-18 WGCL was still obtaining the building construction/modification certificate. The sale agreement requires complete permits; if not obtained, the manager may postpone or abandon the acquisition. Due diligence may also miss latent defects or non-compliance.

source.section: ความเสี่ยงเกี่ยวกับการได้มาซึ่งอสังหาริมทรัพย์ของกองทรัสต์ WHART

risks.title: Rainwater retention pond maintenance obligations
risks.summary: The trust must share maintenance, improvement and repair costs of the rainwater pond used jointly with WGCL, including after the WGCL lease ends, on terms still to be agreed.

risks.summary: Up to THB 54 mn of WGCL's ~THB 77.52 mn deposit will fund the purchase, so the deposit is not fully reserved; refunds on lease end could reduce distributions or require borrowing.

risks.title: Related-party acquisition and conflicts of interest
risks.summary: Seller/tenant WGCL is 50% owned by WHA Venture Holding (WHA Corporation 99.99%). WHA also controls the REIT manager (99.99%), is property manager on a fixed 30-year fee schedule and holds 15% of units.

source.section: 5.2.3 ความเสี่ยงจากความขัดแย้งทางผลประโยชน์ที่อาจเกิดขึ้น

risks.summary: Up to THB 2,507.6 mn of new floating-rate debt (<= MLR-1.50%), bullet within 3 years, possibly secured on trust assets; LTV rises from 28.45% to up to about 33.07%. 63.48% of interest-bearing debt already matures within one year (1Q2026).

risks.summary: After the deal, leases on 14.37% of area expire in 2026, 14.31% in 2027, 15.84% in 2028 and 10.52% in 2029; renewals may be at lower rents or not happen.

risks.summary: Existing portfolio occupancy was 86.75% in 1Q2026 before undertaking income; when WHA's 3-year vacant-space support ends, the trust must find tenants or lose that income.

risks.title: Declining value of leasehold assets
risks.summary: Most existing projects are leasehold/sub-leasehold (shortest DKSH/Intanon to about 2035); their value falls towards zero as the remaining term shortens, and some carry demolition/return obligations.

risks.title: Tenant purchase options / right of first refusal
risks.summary: Some leases give tenants the right to buy the leased property; WGCL gets a right of first refusal on any sale of the new asset (at the higher of a third-party offer and the average of two appraisals).

source.section: ความเสี่ยงที่เกี่ยวข้องกับอสังหาริมทรัพย์

ambiguities.detail: Risks 5.4.4 (uploaded 2026-08-14) refers to up to 160,000,000 units with >=50% to existing holders and dilution up to 4.41%; the later cover, fact sheet and offering section (2026-08-27) state up to 127,545,000 units, ~100% to existing holders. Latest documents used.
Projection uses 3,594.39 mn post-deal units, 1.98 mn fewer than 3,468.83 + 127.545 mn; the filing says unit numbers are for reference only.

31,992 sqm in the NewAssets summary row vs 31,922 sqm in UseOfProceeds (= 12,274 + 19,648). 31,922 is used because only it reconciles to the stated 1,915,361.04 sqm total; the summary row appears to be a typo.
Appraisal footnote says December-2025 acquisitions are shown at purchase price, but the table shows THB 786.88 mn vs purchase price THB 769.34 mn (769.335 mn in UseOfProceeds).
Detail tables give 1 Dec 2022 as investment date; the investment history table gives 2 Dec 2022.
33.07% maximum after fundraising; whether lease liabilities are included is not stated.
Loan facility cap (THB 2,507.6 mn) equals the full asset price and is joined to equity with 'and/or'; base case uses ~THB 1,197.65 mn.

Portfolio summary table labels the new asset round as 'เพิ่มทุนครั้งที่ 9' (capital increase no.) rather than investment no. 12; draft sale agreement misspells project as 'จีซีดับบลิวแอล'. IRR stated as '9.742/3' in Leasing (footnote markers), 9.74% in Fact Sheet.
